description: The bar chart illustrates the macro F-score performance of two models, RECA and GAIT_GAT, across three frequency categories: High, Medium, and Low, with the y-axis representing the macro F-score on a scale from 0 to 1. The x-axis categorizes the data by frequency, with "High" being the first category, followed by "Medium," and "Low." The legend indicates that RECA is represented by light pink bars and GAIT_GAT by orange bars. For the "High" frequency category, RECA achieves a macro F-score of 0.837, while GAIT_GAT achieves a higher score of 0.877. In the "Medium" frequency category, RECA scores 0.538, and GAIT_GAT scores 0.609. For the "Low" frequency category, RECA has a score of 0.114, and GAIT_GAT has a score of 0.224. The chart shows that GAIT_GAT consistently outperforms RECA across all frequency levels, with the performance gap being most pronounced in the "Low" frequency category.
